metatags.contenttitle: Agencies Issue Joint Statement on Risk-Management Considerations For Crypto-Asset Safekeeping
metatags.og:description: Federal bank regulatory agencies today issued a joint statement in their continued efforts to provide clarity on banks' engagement in crypto-asset-related activities. The statement highlights for banks potential risk-management considerations related to holding crypto-assets on their customers' behalf, or crypto-asset safekeeping.
